# Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks

Unified Android/iOS background-task abstraction. Schedule one-time and periodic work through JobScheduler and BGTaskScheduler.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-background-tasks
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.6 (3 September 2026). Android JobService logs handler exceptions. OperationCanceledException is a cancelled run and is not retried.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks

Registration: `UseBackgroundTasks` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I run periodic background work in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI JobScheduler / BGTaskScheduler wrapper
- How do I schedule a background sync on Android and iOS?

## Do not use when

- Work must never be lost — use Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
- Long-running user-visible work (music, navigation, large uploads) — use a foreground service / NSURLSession
